templar.title: Templar notes
items: Line up {Divine Toll} → {Hammer of Light} with big trash pulls and add phases
Keep SotR up even while bursting. Key tank busters: {busters}

lightsmith.title: Lightsmith notes
items: When to put {Holy Bulwark} on yourself: {busters}
During add or AoE damage phases, put {Holy Bulwark} on the healer or a squishy ally
Line up {Sacred Weapon} with big trash pulls and add phases

Rav'i: [탱버] Keep SotR up for Hydrastrike; if your health is low, use Ardent Defender or Guardian of Ancient Kings
[해제] Cleanse the disease debuff from party members hit by Regurgitate with Cleanse Toxins
[참고] During Ssscavenging AoE damage, prop up endangered party members with Word of Glory
[위치] If the empty pile is far, use Divine Steed to move fast and drag the boss over
The Writhing Coil: [차단] Assign Rebuke and Avenger's Shield as separate slots in the Toxic Atrophy kick rotation
[해제] Spiteful Venom, stacked in melee by the Writhes during Uncoil, is a poison, so clear it with Cleanse Toxins (8 sec cooldown) starting with the party member who has the most stacks
[위치] During Death Rattle, move away quickly with Divine Steed to break the Vine Grip tether
[제어] At the start of Uncoil, use Divine Toll on the gathered Writhes to focus damage, and delay any Writhe casting Toxic Atrophy with Hammer of Justice or Blinding Light
Zul'jan: [탱버] Have SotR up for Chop Down; if your health is low, use Ardent Defender or Guardian of Ancient Kings
[참고] Join the group in the agreed Boneslicer line to clear your Ritual Venom too; Chop Down only clears 2 stacks
[위치] If your beam spot is far, use Divine Steed to get there before Ritual of the Fang starts
[참고] Support party members with the Boneslicer DoT using Word of Glory

Lightblossom Trinity: [탱버] Keep SotR up right before Bedrock Slam and add Ardent Defender in high keys.
[차단] Interrupt Kezkitt's Light Bolt with Rebuke or Avenger's Shield.
[참고] Put Blessing of Protection on an ally with a big Thornblade bleed to block the physical bleed damage.
[참고] When Bedrock Surge and Overgrowth overlap, top up allies with Word of Glory.
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [해제] Use Blessing of Freedom on rooted allies, especially the Bloodthirsty Gaze target, to free them from Bloodthorn Roots.
[참고] If the Bloodthirsty Gaze target is about to be caught, block Incise's physical bleed damage with Blessing of Protection.
[탱버] Ardent Defender for Thorncaller Roar; Guardian of Ancient Kings for Thorncaller Roar during Frenzy.
[회피] If the tank is the Bloodthirsty Gaze target, gain distance with Divine Steed.
Lightwarden Ruia: [탱버] Keep SotR up at all times during Bear Form and use Guardian of Ancient Kings on overlapping windows.
[차단] Warden's Wrath, cast repeatedly on the tank during Moonkin Form, is Nature magic damage that SotR armor does not reduce, so interrupt it with Rebuke or Avenger's Shield.
[참고] Heal allies with Grievous Thrash to full with Word of Glory to clear the bleed.
[탱버] After 40%, split Ardent Defender and Guardian of Ancient Kings across the phase.
Ziekket: [탱버] Thornspike deals Holy 193965 and then a 58189 Physical bleed every sec for 10 sec. SotR only reduces the bleed, so turn on SotR before the cast and add Ardent Defender in high keys.
[차단] Lightspore Shot from Lashers before revival usually targets the tank, so interrupt it with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke, and use Divine Toll to interrupt several casts at once.
[차단] Blinding Light and Hammer of Justice work on Lashers before revival, so use them to stop casts.
[참고] Top off allies with high Essence stacks using Word of Glory.

The Hoardmonger: [해제] When Toxic Spores stacks build, use Cleanse Toxins on yourself or on the party member with the most stacks.

[참고] Ravenous Bellow and Hearty Bellow hit the whole party, not the tank, with armor-ignoring Physical damage that SotR does not reduce. Save big cooldowns and cast Word of Glory on low-health party members.
[위치] Reach distant mushrooms with Divine Steed and soak them within 12 sec.
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Split interrupts on both Shivercores' Winter's Shroud with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke.
[탱버] If you have to take Frozen Tempest outside Snowdrift, pop Ardent Defender.
[위치] If nobody can step on Rimeshatter, the tank steps on it and heals with Word of Glory.
Nalorakk: [탱버] Overwhelming Onslaught (315193 armor-ignoring Physical every sec, 3 hits) is not reduced by SotR, so take it behind Zul'jarra's shield with Guardian of Ancient Kings or Ardent Defender. Alternate the two on each Onslaught.

[탱버] Forceful Slam right after the knockback (5 sec cast, 775859 Physical within 6 yd) is Physical damage that armor reduces, so soak it with SotR. Ardent Defender (12 sec) pressed on the first Onslaught hit can last until Forceful Slam lands.
[위치] If the knockback pushes you away, return to the Forceful Slam spot quickly with Divine Steed.
[탱버] If you are an Echoing Maul target, press Sentinel for the Echo landing (193965 Nature), and self-heal with Word of Glory when Spectral Slash or Echoing Fury damage stacks up.

Kystia Manaheart: [차단] Throw Avenger's Shield into the Mirror Images to silence several copies, and interrupt the rest with Rebuke.
[차단] If the copies are grouped, stop Felstorm with Blinding Light or Hammer of Justice.
[해제] Corroding Spittle is magic, so Cleanse Toxins cannot remove it. Leave it to the healer.

[탱버] Chaos Barrage (3 sec cast, 290947 Chaos) is magic damage that SotR armor does not reduce. Press Ardent Defender (12 sec) before back-to-back casts to cover two hits, and use Sentinel or Guardian of Ancient Kings on the next set.
Zaen Bladesorrow: [탱버] Use Guardian of Ancient Kings on the melee damage from the worker pack dragged into the pull at the start.
[탱버] Stack Ardent Defender on SotR during the Envenom cast (3 sec cast, 436421 Physical).
[해제] Right after Envenom, remove Heartstop Poison from yourself with Cleanse Toxins.
[회피] If you are too late to hide behind a crate during Murder in a Row, take it with Divine Shield (immunity to all damage for 8 sec).
Xathuux the Annihilator: [탱버] On every Legion Strike (3 sec cast, 533403 Physical, 80% reduced healing received for 8 sec), alternate Guardian of Ancient Kings and Ardent Defender on top of SotR.
[탱버] During the 15 sec of Demonic Rage, melee swings with 75% more attack speed are Physical, so keep SotR rolling and press Sentinel.
[탱버] In the Infernal Crush window right after Axe Toss, use whichever of Ardent Defender or Guardian of Ancient Kings is left.
[위치] Use Divine Steed to move the boss quickly to the axe.
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Interrupt Chaos Bolt with Rebuke or Avenger's Shield.
[차단] Stop Felfire Burst from Wild Imp packs with Avenger's Shield and Blinding Light.
[탱버] Shadow Bite (38793 Shadow) added to each Furious Vilefiend melee hit is not reduced by SotR, so press Ardent Defender or Sentinel when the Vilefiend spawns.
[위치] On the pull, drag the boss to the farthest corner with Divine Steed, and use Divine Steed again to get away from the Infernal.

Taz'Rah: [탱버] Void Blast (2 sec cast, 271551 Shadow + knockback) is not reduced by SotR, so alternate Ardent Defender and Guardian of Ancient Kings every time, and take it with Sentinel when both are down.
[회피] If the knockback lands you in a pool, get out immediately with Divine Steed.
[탱버] Right after Dark Bloom, cast Word of Glory on a low-health party member.
Atroxus: [탱버] Hulking Claw (2 sec cast, 242456 Nature + 10 sec Nature DoT) is not reduced by SotR, so rotate Ardent Defender, Guardian of Ancient Kings, and Sentinel in turn, and fill the turn when all three are down with Word of Glory self-heals.
[회피] If Toxic Creeper is about to catch you, open distance with Divine Steed.
[탱버] If your health drops sharply from Hulking Claw after Sickening Bite, use Lay on Hands.
[해제] Dispel the Poison Splash poison DoT and Mind-Numbing Poison on party members who stepped in Poison Pool with Cleanse Toxins.
Charonus: [탱버] Dark Waves (5 sec cast, 339438 Shadow) is not reduced by SotR, so alternate Ardent Defender and Guardian of Ancient Kings, and fill gaps with Sentinel.
[참고] Cast Blessing of Freedom on a DPS whose Condensed Mass slow stacks make it hard to drag the orb to a Singularity, so they arrive faster. The stacks only disappear when the orb is destroyed.
[탱버] Cast Word of Glory on party members whose health dropped from the Cosmic Crash DoT.

The Golden Serpent: [탱버] Keep SotR up when Tail Thrash is cast
[차단] Use Blinding Light or Hammer of Justice on Animated Gold packs heading to the boss
[위치] Reposition quickly with Divine Steed when dragging the boss around the gold piles
Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Put Avenger's Shield and Rebuke on the mummies' Wretched Discharge first
[해제] A missed Wretched Discharge is a disease, so remove it with Cleanse Toxins. Its cooldown is 8 sec, so cleanse the lowest player first
[참고] Cast Word of Glory on the Desiccation target to help them reach 90% health
[위치] When Entomb happens, move from the room center to the shaking coffin quickly with Divine Steed
The Council of Tribes: [탱버] Pop Guardian of Ancient Kings right after Backhand and hold, or kite with Divine Steed if it is not available
[탱버] Arc Lightning (135775 Nature) hits the tank right after Zanazal is engaged and is not reduced by SotR armor, so engage with Sentinel up and follow with Ardent Defender
[차단] Assign Avenger's Shield or Rebuke to Poison Nova and make sure it is interrupted
[해제] If Poison Nova goes through, dispel the poison immediately with Cleanse Toxins
Dazar, The First King: [탱버] In phase 1 (Reban), take hits with SotR alone and save Ardent Defender and Guardian of Ancient Kings

[탱버] After 80%, when Blade Combo follows Savage Maul (Physical + bleed, 10% more Physical damage taken), use Guardian of Ancient Kings (2 charges), and Ardent Defender on the next overlap. If both are on cooldown, use Sentinel and ask for an external
[차단] Assign Avenger's Shield and Rebuke to Reban's Deathly Roar

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] Interrupt Frigid Shard yourself with Avenger's Shield or Rebuke right after the Hailburst ice lands, and drag the boss out of the ice.
[탱버] A missed Frigid Shard (775859 Physical) is reduced by SotR armor, so keep SotR up, and add Ardent Defender if several are missed in a row.

[해제] Cold Claws is magic, which Protection Paladin cannot remove, so ask the healer to dispel. If their dispel is on cooldown and you near 20 stacks, cast Blessing of Spellwarding (10 sec immunity to magical effects) on yourself to stop more stacks.
[참고] When Infused Whelps spawn, use Divine Toll to throw Avenger's Shield at several of them and grab aggro.
Kokia Blazehoof: [탱버] Turn on SotR before Searing Blows (4 Physical hits, each stacking a Searing Wounds Fire DoT), and alternate Ardent Defender and Sentinel each cast.
[탱버] SotR does not reduce the Fire DoT, so in high keys stack Guardian of Ancient Kings to cut both the Physical hits and the DoT.
[차단] Use Rebuke or Avenger's Shield on Blaze Volley.
[참고] Self-heal with Word of Glory when the Searing Wounds Fire DoT drains your health.
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [탱버] Take Stormslam with SotR only, and save Ardent Defender and Guardian of Ancient Kings for the moment the Inferno Spit circle explodes when you are targeted.
[해제] The Stormslam Nature vulnerability is a magic debuff that Cleanse Toxins cannot remove, so leave it to the healer before the next Stormslam.
[탱버] In phase 2, Inferno Spit targets 3 players, so enter with one GoAK charge and Sentinel saved.

Adderis & Aspix: [탱버] Keep Shield of the Righteous up during Overload and use Ardent Defender when things overlap.
[위치] If Gale Force pushes you far, return with Divine Steed and join the Thunder and Lightning soak.
[탱버] If the Gust target is in danger, help heal them with Word of Glory.
Merektha: [탱버] Lightning Bite (533403 Physical + 7 sec Nature DoT) needs a cooldown every time, so keep SotR up and rotate Ardent Defender, Sentinel, and Guardian of Ancient Kings one per cast. SotR does not reduce the Nature DoT, so get through it with Word of Glory.
[위치] Watch the egg spots before Hatch and throw Avenger's Shield at the Storm Serpent first to grab aggro. If there are several, grab them at once with Divine Toll.
[차단] Interrupt Toxic Viper's Poison Spit with Rebuke and Avenger's Shield, and dispel the DoT with Cleanse Toxins.
[위치] When A Knot of Snakes targets gather, free them all at once with Blinding Light.
Galvazzt: [참고] The tank does not soak beams. If a beam soaker is in danger, save them with Word of Glory or Lay on Hands, and cast Blessing of Sacrifice (30% damage reduction for 12 sec) on a soaker with high Galvanized stacks.
[위치] Each time Induction Field lands, move the boss quickly to the next corner with Divine Steed.
Avatar of Sethraliss: [위치] When the Corrupted Guardian spawns on the purple floor marker, throw Avenger's Shield to grab aggro before it reaches the DPS, and drag the Twisted Hexxer next to the Guardian too.

[탱버] Time SotR for Tainted Strike (484912 Physical + stacking 25 sec Shadow DoT) and use Ardent Defender. SotR does not reduce the Shadow DoT, so use Guardian of Ancient Kings as stacks build and top yourself off with Word of Glory.
[차단] Interrupt Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock with Rebuke and Avenger's Shield.
[위치] Lock down Faithless Tormentors heading for the healer with Blinding Light or Hammer of Justice, and hit several at once with Divine Toll when they come in.

6940.m: Talent · 1.4% of base mana · 40 yd range · Instant · 2 min cooldown
6940.d:
Blesses a party or raid member, reducing their damage taken by 30%, but you suffer 100% of damage prevented.
Last 12 sec, or until transferred damage would cause you to fall below 20% health.

26573.d: Consecrates the land beneath you, causing [Burning Crusade: [((5% of Attack Power) * ceil12) * 1.05] Radiant / [((5% of Attack Power) * ceil12) * 1.05] Holy] damage over 12 sec to enemies who enter the area [Consecrated Ground: and reducing their movement speed by 50% / .] Limit 1.

114154.d: Reduces the cooldown of your Divine Shield, [Shield of Vengeance: Shield of Vengeance] [Ardent Defender / Divine Protection], and Lay on Hands by 30%.

204018.m: Talent · 3% of base mana · 40 yd range · Instant · 5 min cooldown · 1 Charge · Requires level 35 (Protection)
204018.d:
Blesses a party or raid member, granting immunity to magical damage and harmful effects for 10 sec.
Cannot be used on a target with Forbearance. Causes Forbearance for 30 sec.
Shares a cooldown with Blessing of Protection.

204074.d: Avenging Wrath and Sentinel have 50% reduced cooldown and 40% reduced duration.

204077.d: During Divine Shield, all targets within 15 yds are taunted.

389539.d:
Call upon the Light and gain 15 stacks of Divine Resolve, increasing your maximum health by 1% and reducing your damage taken by 2% per stack for 20 sec. After 5.0 sec, you will begin to lose 1 stack per second, but each 3 Holy Power spent will delay the loss of your next stack by 1 sec.
While active, your damage and healing are increased by 10%, and critical strike chance is increased by 10%.

391054.d:
3 Holy Power / 2% of base mana · · 40 yd range
2 sec cast · · 10 min cooldown
Requires Paladin
Requires level 19
Petition the Light on the behalf of a fallen ally, restoring spirit to body and allowing them to reenter battle with 60% health and at least 20% mana.

432459.m: Talent · 40 yd range · Instant · 1 min recharge · 2 Charges
432459.d:
Will the Light to coalesce and become manifest as a Holy Armament, wielded by your friendly target.
Holy Bulwark:
While wielding a Holy Bulwark, gain an absorb shield for 15.0% of your max health and an additional 2.0% every 2 sec. Lasts 20 sec.
Becomes Sacred Weapon after use.

1246481.d: Guardian of Ancient Kings has 1 additional charge.

234299.d: Hammer of Justice's cooldown is reduced by 15 sec.

305394.d: Blessing of Freedom increases movement speed by 30%, and you gain Blessing of Freedom when cast on a friendly target.

6940.m: 특성 · 1.4% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
6940.d:
대상 파티원 또는 공격대원을 축복하여 대상이 받는 피해를 30%만큼 감소시키지만, 감소한 피해의 100%를 자신이 입습니다.
12초 동안 또는 이전된 피해로 자신의 생명력이 20% 미만으로 떨어질 때까지 지속됩니다.

26573.d: 자신이 서 있는 땅을 신성화하여 그 지역에 접근하는 적에게 12초에 걸쳐 총 [불타는 성전: [((전투력의 5%) * ceil12) * 1.05]의 광휘 / [((전투력의 5%) * ceil12) * 1.05]의 신성] 피해를 입 [신성한 대지: 히고 이동 속도를 50%만큼 감소시킵니다 / 힙니다.] 효과는 최대 1회만 발동합니다.

114154.d: 천상의 보호막, [복수의 방패: 복수의 방패] [헌신적인 수호자 / 신의 가호], 신의 축복 주문의 재사용 대기시간이 30%만큼 감소합니다.

204018.m: 특성 · 3% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 5 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능 · 요구 레벨 35 (보호)
204018.d:
대상 파티원 또는 공격대원에게 축복을 내려, 10초 동안 모든 마법 피해 및 해로운 효과에 면역이 되게 합니다.
참을성 상태인 대상에게는 사용할 수 없습니다. 대상은 이후 30초 동안 참을성 상태가 됩니다.
보호의 축복과 재사용 대기시간을 공유합니다.

204074.d: 응징의 격노 및 파수꾼의 재사용 대기시간이 50%만큼, 지속시간은 40%만큼 감소합니다.

204077.d: 천상의 보호막의 지속시간 동안 15미터 내의 모든 대상을 도발합니다.

389539.d:
빛의 힘을 불러내어 신성한 결의 15중첩을 얻습니다. 20초 동안 중첩 하나당 최대 생명력이 1%만큼 증가하고 받는 피해는 2%만큼 감소합니다. 5.0초가 지나면 1초마다 1중첩씩 사라집니다. 단, 신성한 힘 3개를 소모할 때마다 다음 중첩이 1초 늦게 사라집니다.
효과가 활성화된 동안 시전자의 공격력과 치유량이 10%만큼, 치명타 및 극대화율은 10%만큼 증가합니다.

391054.m: 신성한 힘 3개 / 2% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 2 초 주문 시전 시간 · 10 분 재사용 대기시간
391054.d: 쓰러진 아군을 위해 빛에 읍소하여 영혼을 육신으로 되돌려 60%의 생명력과 20% 이상의 마나를 지닌 상태로 부활시킵니다.

432459.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간 · 2회 사용 가능
432459.d:
의지의 힘으로 빛을 그러모아 신성한 무장으로 실체화한 뒤, 아군 대상이 착용할 수 있도록 합니다.
신성한 보루:
신성한 보루를 사용 중일 때 최대 생명력의 15.0%에 해당하는 피해 흡수 보호막을 얻고 2초마다 피해 흡수량이 2.0%만큼 증가합니다. 20초 동안 지속됩니다.
사용 후 신성한 무기가 됩니다.

305394.d: 자유의 축복이 이동 속도를 30%만큼 증가시키고, 아군 대상에게 시전 시 자신 또한 자유의 축복을 얻습니다.

1: [탱버] For Virid Grovekeeper's Earthrupture Strike (533403 Physical, 2.5 sec cast), keep SotR up and use Ardent Defender (30% damage reduction for 12 sec, 63 sec cooldown with Unbreakable Spirit). If Spouting Floret lands at the same time, add Guardian of Ancient Kings (50% reduction for 8 sec).

[차단] Interrupt Radiant Spellsower's Light Bolt Volley with Avenger's Shield or Rebuke so the Radiant Spellsower walks to you. If it runs to a Lasher pack with Call The Grove, stun it with Hammer of Justice (30 sec cooldown with Fist of Justice).

[참고] When Spore Spines slows from 13 Lashers stack up, cast Blessing of Freedom on yourself to ignore movement impairing effects for 8 sec. With Unbound Freedom you also receive it when you cast it on an ally.
2: [탱버] Spouting Floret (Holy 87284 every 2 sec for 6 sec) is not reduced by SotR armor. Ardent Defender from pull 1 is still on cooldown, so take it with Sentinel (1 min cooldown and 12 sec duration with Righteous Protector).
[차단] If both Radiant Spellsowers cast Light Bolt Volley together, use Divine Toll to throw Avenger's Shield at up to 5 enemies and interrupt both at once.
3: [탱버] Use Ardent Defender, back after 63 sec, on Earthrupture Strike. If it is still on cooldown, spend the remaining Guardian of Ancient Kings charge (2 charges with Empyrean Authority).
[차단] Interrupt the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley one each with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke so they walk in, and stun the one that runs off with Call The Grove using Hammer of Justice.
[참고] When Spore Spines stacks from 12 Lashers slow you down, cast Blessing of Freedom on yourself.
5: [탱버] Pull Sporeblight Belcher first and take Spouting Floret with Sentinel, then use Ardent Defender on Earthrupture Strike from Virid Grovekeeper pulled 5-6 sec later.
[제어] Stun Thorny Saptor's Thornclaw Leap with Hammer of Justice, and interrupt Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Rebuke or Avenger's Shield.
7: [탱버] When Grievous Gash (387930 Physical + stacking bleed) from the two Luminous Thornmaws overlaps, use Guardian of Ancient Kings. On the Lightsmith build, cast Holy Bulwark (15% max health shield, 2 charges) on yourself before the pull.
[참고] The Grievous Gash bleed only drops at full health, so cast Word of Glory on yourself, and if stacks pile up, top off at once with Lay on Hands (7 min cooldown with Unbreakable Spirit).
[제어] Stop the two Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap one at a time with Hammer of Justice, and interrupt Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Rebuke.
8: [탱버] Use whichever of Sentinel or Ardent Defender is back first on Spouting Floret. SotR does not reduce this Holy damage.
[제어] Stop the two Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap with Hammer of Justice, and interrupt Leafy Grovecrawler's Seed Shot with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke when free.
10: [탱버] Potatoad Matriarch's Tongue Toss (290947 Physical + knock up) is fully reduced by SotR armor, so keep SotR rolling and save big cooldowns for the Luminous Thornmaw in pull 11.
[해제] Toxic Spew is a poison dealing Nature 58189 every 1.5 sec for 9 sec. Cleanse Toxins has an 8 sec cooldown and frees only one player at a time, so split dispel targets with the healer.
11: [탱버] Use Guardian of Ancient Kings on Luminous Thornmaw's Grievous Gash, and add Ardent Defender if Spouting Floret overlaps. Clear the bleed by casting Word of Glory on yourself to reach full health.
[차단] If the three Lightfeather Petalwings cast Disorienting Screech together, use Divine Toll to throw Avenger's Shield at all three and interrupt them.
12: [탱버] Use Sentinel for the opening window where Pollen Surge (50% attack speed) on six Lightgorged Lashers overlaps Spouting Floret, and follow with Ardent Defender if the Lightbloom Pollination shields last long.
[차단] Interrupt the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley with Divine Toll or Avenger's Shield and Rebuke so they walk in, and stun one with Hammer of Justice if it runs off with Call The Grove.

1: [탱버] Ravenous Claws attack speed stacks from the seven Ravenous Descendants are Physical melee damage, so SotR armor reduces them. Press Sentinel (1 min cooldown and 12 sec duration with Righteous Protector) on the pull, and hand off to Ardent Defender (30% damage reduction for 12 sec, 63 sec cooldown with Unbreakable Spirit) when the stacks start to drain your health.

[차단] Piercing Hiss from the two Primal Serpents (4 sec cast, 135775 Physical that ignores armor + 30% haste reduction) is not reduced by SotR. Take one Serpent each with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke to fill two slots of the kick rotation.
[제어] Stun a Ravenous Descendant with high stacks for 6 sec with Hammer of Justice (30 sec cooldown with Fist of Justice) so its attack speed stacks fall off.
2: [탱버] Ritual Chieftain's Dismember (3 sec cast, 581895 Physical) is a single Physical hit that SotR armor reduces. If you used Sentinel in pull 1, take this one with Ardent Defender.
[제어] If you are short on cooldowns, stun the Ritual Chieftain with Hammer of Justice while the Dismember cast bar is up to stop the cast.
[참고] When Blood Sacrifice (87284 Physical to the whole party + 162029 heal absorb) lands, cast Word of Glory on party members who still carry the absorb to clear it.
3: [차단] If the three Primal Serpents that walk down behind the pillar cast Piercing Hiss together, use Divine Toll (1 min cooldown) to throw Avenger's Shield at all three and interrupt them at once.
[탱버] For Dismember, use Sentinel if it is back 1 min after pull 1. Otherwise spend one charge of Guardian of Ancient Kings (50% damage reduction for 8 sec, 2 charges with Empyrean Authority).
4: [탱버] Use the Ardent Defender from pull 2, back after 63 sec, on Dismember. If it is still on cooldown, stun the Ritual Chieftain with Hammer of Justice to stop the cast.
5: [탱버] Toxic Breath (67888 Nature every 0.5 sec) and Paralyzing Shots from the two Twinfang Harrowers are Nature damage that SotR does not reduce, and Ritual Chieftain's Dismember overlaps them, so this is the most dangerous pull on the route. Use Guardian of Ancient Kings here, and add Sentinel if it is back.
[차단] Interrupt Piercing Hiss from both Primal Serpents together with Divine Toll, and keep Rebuke for the next cast.

[참고] On the Lightsmith build, use one Holy Bulwark charge (15% max health shield, 2 charges) on yourself and put the other on the healer or a party member taking the Paralyzing Shots DoT for a long time.
7: [탱버] Rattling Writhe's Corrosive Fangs (3 sec cast, 242456 Nature, 20% increased damage taken for 20 sec) is not reduced by SotR. In high keys, if Ardent Defender is not enough, cast Blessing of Spellwarding (immunity to magical damage and harmful effects for 10 sec, 5 min cooldown) on yourself to block both the damage and the debuff. Forbearance then locks out Lay on Hands and Divine Shield for 30 sec.
[차단] Interrupt High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom (3.5 sec cast) with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke, and stop the Evolve channel (6 sec) by stunning with Hammer of Justice.
8: [탱버] If you used Ardent Defender in pull 7, take this Corrosive Fangs with Sentinel (up to 30% damage reduction regardless of school) and save Guardian of Ancient Kings for pull 9.

[제어] When the four Bloodletters stack blood pools under you, use Blinding Light (1 min 30 sec cooldown, 6 sec disorient) to stop their melee and move the pack out of the pools. Damage breaks the disorient.
9: [탱버] Use the remaining Guardian of Ancient Kings charge or a returned Ardent Defender on Corrosive Fangs.
[차단] Interrupt Mass Envenom from the High Evolutionist next to you with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke, and stop the Evolve channel by stunning with Hammer of Justice.
11: [차단] If the four High Evolutionists cast Mass Envenom (3.5 sec cast) together, use Divine Toll to throw Avenger's Shield at all four and interrupt them at once.

[제어] Stop the Evolve channel (heals 5% per sec for 6 sec, then grants a shield and crowd control immunity) with Hammer of Justice, and if two or more gathered Evolutionists channel together, break them with Blinding Light.
12: [탱버] Ascendant Serpent's Noxious Spray (3 sec cast, then 67888 Nature every sec for 5 sec) is not reduced by SotR. Take the first one with Ardent Defender and the second with Sentinel or Guardian of Ancient Kings while facing away from the party and resisting the pushback.
13: [차단] Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom must be interrupted every time, so alternate Avenger's Shield and Rebuke (both 15 sec cooldown) to cover two casts yourself.
[제어] When Toxic Surge starts, stun one Blade of the Altar with Hammer of Justice, and if two are stacked, hold both with Blinding Light to stop their teleport attacks.
[참고] The Templar build's Divine Toll → Hammer of Light AoE burst can melt the Living Venoms all at once. Aim it at Ula'tek's Chosen, and delay it if the Living Venoms are clumped next to the Chosen.
14: [차단] Take Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke, and stun a Blade of the Altar with Hammer of Justice during Toxic Surge.
[참고] On the Lightsmith build, when Toxic Surge (29095 Nature every sec for 9 sec) starts, cast Holy Bulwark on the healer or a low-health party member to support them through the AoE.
15: [차단] Interrupt Piercing Hiss from the two Primal Serpents one each with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke. If you miss one and take the 30% haste reduction, survive those 6 sec with Ardent Defender.
16: [탱버] Dismember (581895 Physical) from the two Ritual Chieftains comes back to back, so split Guardian of Ancient Kings and Ardent Defender one each on top of SotR. If both are down, stun one Chieftain with Hammer of Justice to stop the cast.
[차단] Cover Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke, and do not miss a single cast while the party kills the Chosen before the second Toxic Surge.

[참고] Blood Sacrifice heal absorbs overlap twice, so cast Word of Glory on party members with large absorbs, and if the healer collapses, use Lay on Hands (7 min cooldown with Unbreakable Spirit) on the healer.

1: [탱버] Shadow-Borne Champion's Shadow Whirlwind (164870 Shadow, 4 sec cast) is not reduced by SotR armor, so use Ardent Defender (30% damage reduction for 12 sec, 63 sec cooldown with Unbreakable Spirit) on the first cast and Sentinel (1 min cooldown and 12 sec duration with Righteous Protector) on the next. Heavy Slams from the two Animated Guardians are Physical, so keep SotR rolling.
[제어] Stun the Minion of Zul on the way for 6 sec with Hammer of Justice (30 sec cooldown with Fist of Justice) to buy time for the purge.
2: [탱버] For the second Shadow-Borne Champion's Shadow Whirlwind, use Ardent Defender if it is back from pull 1, otherwise use Guardian of Ancient Kings (50% reduction for 8 sec, 2 charges with Empyrean Authority).
[차단] Risen Hexer's Hex Volley is a curse that Protection Paladin cannot dispel, so always interrupt it with Avenger's Shield (interrupt + 3 sec silence) and Rebuke.
4: [탱버] In the King A'akul group, Mortal Bleed (18 sec Physical bleed, 20% reduced healing taken) stacked with Bloodsworn Assassin's Sudden Rupture makes Blood Drain (164870 Physical) hit the bleeding tank harder. When this group wakes, use Guardian of Ancient Kings with SotR up, and cast Word of Glory on yourself since your healing taken is reduced.

[차단] Queen Wasi's Bind Soul and Soul Bolt must both be interrupted, so alternate Avenger's Shield (3 sec silence) and Rebuke, and interrupt Seneschal M'bara's Unholy Mending with Avenger's Shield too.

[위치] When King Timalji comes at you with Bladestorm (164870 Physical every 0.5 sec), escape with Divine Steed (100% movement speed for 3 sec, 2 charges with Cavalier) and drag the other mobs out of the blades.
5: [광역 피해] Purification Construct's Purifying Flame (174568 Fire to the whole party) is not reduced by SotR, so take it with Sentinel while backing up across the bridge. If the healer cannot keep up and someone is in danger, cast Word of Glory on that player.
[참고] If Embalming Fluid's Putrid Seekers pools (20% movement slow) bog you down, cast Blessing of Freedom on yourself to ignore movement impairing effects for 8 sec.
6: [차단] If both Half-Finished Mummies cast Wretched Discharge (4 sec cast) together, use Divine Toll to throw Avenger's Shield at both. If they cast separately, take one each with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke.

[해제] A missed Wretched Discharge is a disease (116379 Nature every 2 sec for 12 sec), so remove it with Cleanse Toxins. Its cooldown is 8 sec, so cleanse the lowest player first and split the rest with the healer.
7: [차단] If you spent Divine Toll in pull 6, interrupt the two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge one each with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke, and remove any missed disease with Cleanse Toxins.
9: [차단] The two Phantom Hex Priests chain-cast Spectral Bolt and Hex, so on the pull use Divine Toll to throw Avenger's Shield at both for a 3 sec silence, and once they gather within 10 yards, stop the next casts with Blinding Light (6 sec disorient, 1 min 30 sec cooldown).

[탱버] When Bloodthirsty Axe bleeds from the two Royal Berserkers stack up, use Ardent Defender. You can cast Blessing of Protection (10 sec Physical immunity, removes bleeds) on a DPS or healer with heavy bleed stacks, but on yourself it drops your threat on Physical-damage mobs, so do not use it on yourself.
10: [탱버] Use Guardian of Ancient Kings on Ghostly Brute's Soul Crush (727368 Physical, then 30% more Physical damage taken for 15 sec), and keep SotR rolling for the remaining 15 sec of the vulnerability. If Ardent Defender from pull 9 is back, chain it late in the vulnerability.
[회피] When Seismic Upheaval (5 sec cast, 387930 Physical to nearby players + knock up) starts, get out of range with Divine Steed.
[차단] Interrupt the remaining Phantom Hex Priest's Spectral Bolt and Hex with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke.
12: [탱버] Shadow of Zul's Shadow Barrage (58190 Shadow + 4 sec DoT) goes to whoever engages first, so open with Avenger's Shield. It is Shadow magic that SotR armor does not reduce, so take it with whichever of Ardent Defender or Sentinel is ready.

1: [탱버] This is the lust pull where Shield Bash from Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard (3 sec cast, Physical, 20% increased Physical damage taken for 20 sec) overlaps. Use Guardian of Ancient Kings (50% reduction for 8 sec, 2 charges with Empyrean Authority) on the first Shield Bash and Ardent Defender (30% reduction for 12 sec, 63 sec cooldown with Unbreakable Spirit) on the next.
[해제] The two Street Sneaks stack Heartstop Poison (5% max health reduction per stack) on the tank, so rotate Cleanse Toxins (8 sec cooldown) onto yourself. Leave party dispels to the healer.
2: [차단] Take Seduction from the two Seductive Sayaads (3 sec cast, 6 sec disorient) one each with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke, and if both are on cooldown, stun with Hammer of Justice (30 sec cooldown with Fist of Justice) to stop the cast.
3: [탱버] Use Sentinel (1 min cooldown and 12 sec duration with Righteous Protector) with SotR up on Bribed Guard's Shield Bash. The 20% increased Physical damage taken lasts 20 sec, so keep SotR rolling for that time.
4: [제어] The four Street Sneaks stack Heartstop Poison with every melee hit, so stop their attacks with Blinding Light (1 min 30 sec cooldown, 6 sec disorient) and clear your stacks with Cleanse Toxins meanwhile. Damage breaks the disorient.
[탱버] Keep Ardent Defender up while the stacks have lowered your max health.
5: [탱버] Massive Felwyrm's Corroding Spittle is a stacking Fire (magic) DoT on its current target that SotR does not reduce and Cleanse Toxins cannot remove. Ask the healer to dispel it, and press Sentinel or Ardent Defender as stacks build.
8: [차단] A Protection Paladin cannot remove Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast, 60% damage taken reduction + crowd control immunity for 1 min) from the two Wrathguard Flayers with an enrage dispel, so always interrupt it with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke. Stop Fel Invoker's Health Funnel with a remaining kick or Hammer of Justice.

[탱버] Shadow Bite from the two Trained Felhunters (38793 Shadow per melee hit) is not reduced by SotR, so press Ardent Defender. Watch Shivan Punisher's Whirlwind cast bar (4 sec cast, 290947 Physical within 12 yd) and step out past 12 yd.
9: [차단] Interrupt Fel Rage from the two Wrathguard Flayers with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke, and if both cast together, use Divine Toll (1 min cooldown) to throw Avenger's Shield at both.

[참고] Cast Blessing of Spellwarding (immunity to magical damage and harmful effects for 10 sec, 5 min cooldown) on the party member targeted by Corrupted Warlock's Drain Life so the Warlock cannot heal. A Protection Paladin cannot dispel the Curse of Doom curse.
10: [차단] Interrupt Health Funnel from the two Fel Invokers one each with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke.

[참고] When Shivan Punisher deals party Fire damage with Demonic Frenzy below 50%, the Lightsmith build casts Holy Bulwark (15% max health shield, 2 charges) on the healer, and the Templar build melts the Punisher quickly with Divine Toll → Hammer of Light.
11: [탱버] Shadow Bite from the two Trained Felhunters and Felmaster Lucsei's Blade Dance (Fire) are both magic damage that SotR does not reduce. Press Ardent Defender and then Sentinel while Blade Dance comes out.
[참고] On the Lightsmith build, cast one Holy Bulwark charge on the healer right before Blade Dance to support the party through the AoE.
13: [차단] Interrupt Fel Rage from the two Wrathguard Flayers with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke, and use Divine Toll to interrupt Felfire Burst from several Unleashed Imps at once.
[참고] For Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (145474 Fire to the whole party), the Lightsmith build casts Holy Bulwark on the healer, and you take it yourself with Ardent Defender.
14: [차단] If Fel Rage from the two Wrathguard Flayers and Fel Invoker's Health Funnel come together, use Divine Toll to throw Avenger's Shield at all three and interrupt them at once, then cover the next cast with Rebuke.
[탱버] SotR does nothing against Shadow Bite Shadow damage from the two Trained Felhunters, so press Sentinel.
15: [탱버] Shadow Bite from three Trained Felhunters lands all at once, so use Guardian of Ancient Kings and follow with Ardent Defender when it ends. Step out past 12 yd to dodge Shivan Punisher's Whirlwind.
[참고] Cast Blessing of Spellwarding on the party member targeted by Drain Life, and if you already used it in pull 9, support them with Blessing of Sacrifice (30% damage reduction for 12 sec).
16: [차단] Interrupt Health Funnel from the two Fel Invokers one each with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke.
[탱버] When Shadow Bite from the two Trained Felhunters overlaps Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam, press Ardent Defender, and use Sentinel or Guardian of Ancient Kings on the second Defiled Slam.

1: [탱버] Mother's Wrath enrage from the two Territorial Matriarchs (50% increased damage for 1 min, stacking) cannot be removed by a Protection Paladin. If the party has no enrage dispel, open with Guardian of Ancient Kings (50% reduction for 8 sec, 2 charges with Empyrean Authority) and follow with Ardent Defender (30% reduction for 12 sec, 63 sec cooldown with Unbreakable Spirit) so they do not overlap.

[참고] If Razor Dive bleeds from the three Keen-Eyed Strikers (33944 Physical every sec for 10 sec, stacking) pile up on one party member, cast Blessing of Protection (Physical damage immunity for 10 sec, 5 min cooldown) on them to clear the bleed.
2: [차단] Interrupt Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast) and Earth Bolt (116379 Nature) one each with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke, and prioritize Healing Breeze if they overlap.
[탱버] When enrage stacks from the single Matriarch make its hits heavy, press Sentinel (1 min cooldown and 12 sec duration with Righteous Protector).
3: [탱버] Use the Ardent Defender from pull 1, back after 63 sec, on the Matriarch enrage stacks, and interrupt Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze with Avenger's Shield or Rebuke.
4: [탱버] If Razor Dive bleeds from the three Keen-Eyed Strikers stack on you while the Matriarch is enraged, spend the remaining Guardian of Ancient Kings charge and cast Word of Glory on yourself to hold your health.
5: [차단] While you drag this pack to the boss spot as the party clicks the barrels, interrupt Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze with Avenger's Shield (30 yd range). Rebuke is melee range and will not reach while you move.
[탱버] You take Matriarch enrage hits and Razor Dive bleeds while kiting the pack, so move with Sentinel active.
7: [탱버] This is the cooldown pull after the boss, so use Guardian of Ancient Kings and Ardent Defender in turn on the two enraged Territorial Matriarchs, then bridge with Sentinel when both end.
[차단] If both Earthwhisper Tenders cast Healing Breeze together, use Divine Toll (1 min cooldown) to throw Avenger's Shield at both and interrupt them at once.
8: [탱버] Frostbite (67888 Frost) from five Frostfangs is not reduced by SotR, and it overlaps Physical enrage hits from two Matriarchs. Press Ardent Defender first, and when Bloodrush (60% attack speed for 10 sec) comes, follow with Sentinel or a remaining Guardian of Ancient Kings charge.
[참고] If Matriarch enrage stacks keep climbing, be ready to use Lay on Hands (7 min cooldown with Unbreakable Spirit) on yourself.
9: [차단] Interrupt Frigid Roar from the two Frigid Maulers (3.5 sec cast, 50% haste and movement speed reduction) one each with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke. If both are on cooldown, stun with Hammer of Justice (30 sec cooldown with Fist of Justice) to stop the cast.
10: [차단] If both Frigid Maulers cast Frigid Roar together, use Divine Toll to throw Avenger's Shield at both and interrupt them.

[탱버] Frostbite from three Frostfangs is Frost damage that SotR does not reduce, so use the Ardent Defender that came back after pull 8. If you miss Frigid Roar and get slowed, cast Blessing of Freedom on yourself.
11: [회피] Avatar of Determination's Pulverize (4 sec cast, 4 sec stun + 387930 Physical within 12 yd) should be dodged by the tank too: watch the cast bar and step out past 12 yd. If you cannot get out, take it with SotR plus Ardent Defender or Sentinel.
[탱버] Frostbite from two Frostfangs and Nature damage from Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward last a long time, so keep Sentinel up while the Avatar dies.
13: [탱버] Primal Echo from the two Grizzled Warbringers (armor-ignoring Physical, stacking) is not reduced by SotR. Alternate Ardent Defender on the first Echo and Guardian of Ancient Kings on the second.
[차단] Interrupt Arc Lightning from the two Stormbound Mystics (4 sec cast, 193965 Nature, up to 3 targets) one each with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke.
14: [차단] Interrupt Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning with Rebuke, and Lightning Bolt with Avenger's Shield when free. A Protection Paladin cannot remove the Bestial Wrath enrage on the Bonded Beasttamer's pet, so support the pet's fixate target with Blessing of Protection or Blessing of Sacrifice (30% damage reduction for 12 sec).
15: [탱버] The four Grizzled Warbringers alternate Primal Echo, so assign one per Echo in the order Ardent Defender → Guardian of Ancient Kings → Sentinel → Guardian of Ancient Kings. If your health collapses after all of them, use Lay on Hands on yourself.
[차단] Interrupt Arc Lightning from both Stormbound Mystics together with Divine Toll, then split the next casts between Avenger's Shield and Rebuke.
[참고] On the Lightsmith build, while Primal Echo stacks build, put one Holy Bulwark charge (15% max health shield, 2 charges) on yourself and one on the healer.
16: [차단] Alternate Avenger's Shield and Rebuke to cover two of Loa Speaker Nanea's Lightning Bolt casts (2.5 sec cast) yourself.

1: [탱버] Right after pulling everything to the entrance, Tectonic Strike (25% more damage taken, stacking for 8 sec) from four Deepstone Earthshapers piles up, so use Guardian of Ancient Kings (50% reduction for 8 sec) at the start, and use Ardent Defender (30% reduction for 12 sec, 63 sec cooldown) with SotR up for Primal Juggernaut's Crushing Smash (533403 Physical + 145474 Nature).
[제어] If Tectonic Strike stacks get high, use Blinding Light (6 sec disorient) when the Earthshapers are within 10 yards, or stun one with Hammer of Justice and step away to drop the stacks.
[차단] If both Flashfrost Chillweavers channel Ice Shield together, use Divine Toll to throw Avenger's Shield at both. If they channel separately, interrupt one each with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke.
2: [탱버] Use Sentinel (1 min cooldown and 12 sec duration with Righteous Protector) on Primal Juggernaut's Crushing Smash, or Ardent Defender if it is back from pull 1.
[차단] Interrupt Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Avenger's Shield for a 3 sec silence, and the next channel with Rebuke.
3: [탱버] Defier Draghar's Steel Barrage (242456 Physical every 0.5 sec for 3 sec) needs a cooldown every cast, so rotate one per cast: the second Guardian of Ancient Kings charge, Ardent Defender, then Sentinel. Keep SotR rolling.

[제어] If Tectonic Strike stacks are up right before Steel Barrage, stun the Deepstone Earthshaper with Hammer of Justice (30 sec cooldown with Fist of Justice) to cut the stacks, and interrupt Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Avenger's Shield.
5: [제어] The two Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage cannot be interrupted, so gather them within 10 yards and stop both with Blinding Light. If only one channels, stun it with Hammer of Justice.
[차단] Spend Avenger's Shield and Rebuke on Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt first, and put spare interrupts on Blazebound Destroyer's Fiery Blast.
[탱버] A Fiery Blast you could not interrupt (358835 Fire, 4 sec cast) is not reduced by SotR armor, so take it with whichever of Sentinel or Ardent Defender is ready.
6: [탱버] For Flamegullet's Fire Maw (581895 Physical + 96982 Fire, then a 6 sec Fire DoT), turn on SotR and use Guardian of Ancient Kings. SotR does not reduce the Fire DoT, so cast Word of Glory on yourself to get through it.
[탱버] Use Ardent Defender on the Blazebound Destroyer's Fiery Blast in the same pack, and interrupt it first with Avenger's Shield if it is available.
[제어] Stun Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Hammer of Justice.
7: [제어] For the two Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage, use Blinding Light (1 min 30 sec cooldown) if it is back from pull 5. If not, stop one with Hammer of Justice and leave the other to the group's stuns.
[탱버] Interrupt Blazebound Destroyer's Fiery Blast with a spare Avenger's Shield after the two Primalist Cinderweavers' Cinderbolts, and take it with Sentinel if you cannot.
8: [제어] Stop the two Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage with Blinding Light or Hammer of Justice, and spend Avenger's Shield and Rebuke on Cinderbolt first.
[탱버] Use whichever of Ardent Defender or Sentinel is ready on a Fiery Blast you could not interrupt.
10: [탱버] Tempest Channeler's Thunder Blast (387930 Nature, 4 sec cast) is magic damage aimed only at the tank, so SotR does not reduce it. Interrupt it with Avenger's Shield when you have a spare interrupt, and otherwise take it with Ardent Defender or Sentinel.

[참고] If the Lightning Torrent target (7 sec channel, 65463 Nature every sec) is in danger, cast Blessing of Spellwarding (10 sec magic damage immunity) or Blessing of Sacrifice (30% damage reduction for 12 sec) on that player.
[제어] Stun Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Hammer of Justice.
11: [차단] Split Avenger's Shield and Rebuke between Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt and Tempest Channeler's Thunder Blast, and take any missed Thunder Blast with Sentinel or Ardent Defender.
[참고] If you used Blessing of Spellwarding in pull 10, cast Blessing of Sacrifice on this Lightning Torrent target.
12: [광역 피해] While High Channeler Ryvati's Tempest Stormshield is up, turn on Sentinel (10% more damage and healing, less damage taken) and break the shield fast. If it is not broken, a 60 yard 4 sec stun follows, so support party health with Word of Glory.
[참고] If the Lightning Torrent target is in danger, cast Blessing of Sacrifice or a recharged Blessing of Spellwarding on that player.

1: [탱버] Keep SotR rolling against Sandfury Stonefist's Sunder Slam (387930 Physical, 50% more Physical damage taken for 10 sec, stacking), and use Guardian of Ancient Kings (50% reduction for 8 sec) when the second stack lands. Use Ardent Defender (30% reduction for 12 sec, 63 sec cooldown) on the next Sunder Slam.

[차단] On the left route, interrupt the first Storm Adept with Avenger's Shield so it walks to you. If the three Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolts overlap Ground Pound (4 sec cast), use Divine Toll to throw Avenger's Shield at all three.

[해제] Engage before the Shrouded Fang, and if someone still gets hit by Poisoned Cheap Shot (poison, 5 sec stun + 96982 Nature every sec), remove it right away with Cleanse Toxins. Stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Hammer of Justice.
2: [탱버] Use Sentinel (1 min cooldown and 12 sec duration with Righteous Protector) on the second Sandfury Stonefist's Sunder Slam, and chain Ardent Defender from pull 1 as stacks build if it is back.

[해제] Two Shrouded Fangs hide under the stairs, so go in and engage before the DPS. Remove a missed Poisoned Cheap Shot with Cleanse Toxins, and interrupt the two Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt one each with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke.
4: [탱버] Lightning Serpent's Serpent's Stormcall adds Nature damage to its melee for 8 sec, and SotR does not reduce that Nature damage. Use Sentinel for those 8 sec, and drag the mobs out of the Lingering Storm pool that forms when it ends.
[제어] Stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Hammer of Justice, and interrupt Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt with Avenger's Shield.
5: [탱버] Use Guardian of Ancient Kings with SotR up on Krolusk Matriarch's Head Butt (727368 Physical), and chain Ardent Defender when the Sand-Sworn Rider pulled late from the bridge joins.

[차단] The two Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt kills when it lands on a player hit by a Krolusk charge or Cytotoxin, so interrupt both with Divine Toll, then take one each with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke.
[해제] Cleanse Toxins has an 8 sec cooldown, so you can remove Cytotoxin from only one player at a time. Cleanse the Lightning Bolt target first.
6: [차단] Interrupt the two Brood Tenders' Venom Bolt one each with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke, and use a spare interrupt on Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind (5 sec cast), a curse that Protection Paladin cannot dispel.
[탱버] When Serpent's Stormcall from the two Lightning Serpents overlaps, use Ardent Defender. SotR does not reduce the added Nature damage.
7: [해제] Cleanse Toxins (8 sec cooldown) cannot clear Cytotoxin from three Poisonous Vipers alone, so cleanse players who also take Venom Bolt first and split the rest with the healer.
[차단] Interrupt Brood Tender's Venom Bolt with Avenger's Shield so it does not stack on Cytotoxin, and interrupt Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind with Rebuke.
[탱버] Use Sentinel or the remaining Guardian of Ancient Kings charge on the two Lightning Serpents' Serpent's Stormcall.
9: [차단] Interrupt the two Imbued Stormcallers' Lightning Bolt with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke, and if both casts overlap the moment Agitated Nimbus's Release Charge (145474 Nature to the whole party) goes off, interrupt both at once with Divine Toll.
[광역 피해] If the two Nimbi's Release Charges alternate back to back, take them with Sentinel. SotR does not reduce this Nature damage.
10: [차단] Before gathering other mobs, interrupt the two Imbued Stormcallers first with Avenger's Shield (3 sec silence) and Rebuke so they walk to you.
[광역 피해] When Release Charge overlaps Spark Step from four Static Anomalies, use Ardent Defender and cast Word of Glory on players who dropped low.
12: [탱버] Turn on SotR and use Ardent Defender on Orb Watcher's Venomous Slash (581895 Physical, then a 10 sec Nature DoT). SotR does not reduce the Nature DoT, so cast Word of Glory on yourself.
[차단] Interrupt the Temple Disruptor on your side's Essence Disruption with Rebuke, and silence the far Disruptor for 3 sec with Avenger's Shield (30 yd range) or stun it with Hammer of Justice.
13: [탱버] Use Guardian of Ancient Kings or Sentinel on the second Orb Watcher's Venomous Slash. Ardent Defender from pull 12 needs 63 sec to come back.
[차단] Split the two Temple Disruptors' Essence Disruption between Rebuke and Avenger's Shield, as in pull 12.
14: [차단] Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock must be interrupted, so alternate Avenger's Shield and Rebuke. Both have a 15 sec cooldown, so hand casts that come while both are on cooldown to the group's interrupts.
[제어] Gather the four Faithless Tormentors chasing the healer and lock them together with Blinding Light (10 yards, 6 sec disorient) next to the healer, then stun leftovers with Hammer of Justice.

1: [차단] Take the first interrupt on Voidtouched Magi's Shadowbolt Volley (4 sec cast, 193965 Shadow within 60 yd) with Avenger's Shield (30 yd range), and keep Rebuke in case the second kicker misses.

[탱버] If you are the Null Eruption target (145474 Shadow + 5 sec DoT), move out of the party and press Ardent Defender (30% reduction for 12 sec, 63 sec cooldown with Unbreakable Spirit). SotR does not reduce Shadow damage.

[참고] If Feral Saberon's Savage Leap bleed (38793 Physical every sec for 5 sec) stacks on you, cast Blessing of Protection (Physical damage immunity for 10 sec) on yourself to clear it. Forbearance then locks out Lay on Hands and Divine Shield for 30 sec.
2: [참고] When Raj'kess the Spellstorm summons three Orb of Disruption orbs, use Divine Toll (1 min cooldown) to throw Avenger's Shield at all three and help kill them.

[탱버] Thundering Storm's long party AoE (Nature) is not reduced by SotR, so press Sentinel (1 min cooldown and 12 sec duration with Righteous Protector), and on the Lightsmith build cast Holy Bulwark (15% max health shield, 2 charges) on the healer.
3: [탱버] This is the biggest pull, where Savage Leap bleeds from five Feral Saberons overlap Feral Rage (20% melee haste). Open with Guardian of Ancient Kings (50% reduction for 8 sec, 2 charges with Empyrean Authority), follow with Ardent Defender, and save Sentinel for Chitigoth's Insidious Aura channel (87284 Nature every 2 sec for 10 sec).

[참고] If you must move the pack out of Protective Turtle's Shell Guard while slowed by Angry Krolusk's Violent Sand (40% movement speed reduction for 12 sec), cast Blessing of Freedom (30% movement speed with Unbound Freedom) on yourself.
[해제] Sycophantic Tarasek's Melt Armor is a magic effect that Cleanse Toxins cannot remove, so leave it to the healer.
5: [차단] Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yd) is the most important kick in this area, so take it with Rebuke and keep Avenger's Shield and Hammer of Justice (30 sec cooldown with Fist of Justice) as backups.

[탱버] If you become the Watchful Harrower's Void Beam target (43642 Shadow every 0.5 sec for 4 sec) while Savage Shredclaw's Shred Defense (20% increased damage taken for 10 sec) is on you, move out of the party and press Ardent Defender.
6: [차단] Take Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt and Dominated Brawler's Demoralizing Shout one each with Avenger's Shield and Rebuke.

[참고] If Brutal Overseer's Brutal Slams (party Physical damage up 10% per slam) overlaps the Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike soak, press Sentinel and step into the soak circle, and on the Lightsmith build cast Holy Bulwark on the healer.
8: [탱버] Devouring Brutalizer casts Brutalize (2 sec cast, then 678877 Physical every 1.5 sec for 6 sec) right after Dreadbellow. When you see the Dreadbellow cast, turn on SotR and press Guardian of Ancient Kings (8 sec) on the first Brutalize hit to cover the whole channel.
[탱버] If Brutalize comes while Shred Defense (20% increased damage taken) from three Savage Shredclaws is on you, stack Ardent Defender on top.
[차단] Take Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Rebuke, and interrupt Mending Void from the two Voidminders with Avenger's Shield and Divine Toll when free.
9: [탱버] For Brutalize, use the second Guardian of Ancient Kings charge or the Ardent Defender that came back after 63 sec, together with SotR.
[차단] Interrupt Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Rebuke and Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt with Avenger's Shield.
10: [탱버] If no Guardian of Ancient Kings charge is left, stack Ardent Defender and Sentinel on Brutalize, and if both are down, take the channel with Divine Shield (immunity to all damage for 8 sec, Final Stand taunts nearby enemies).
[참고] Cast Blessing of Protection on a party member stacking Savage Leap bleeds from the two Feral Saberons to clear them. If you used it in pull 1, check that its 5 min cooldown is back.
